### Samson Victorious
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/samson-victorious
Passage: Judges 16:28
Points:
- The Philistines celebrated Samson’s capture at Dagon’s temple, assuming their god had triumphed over the God of Israel.
- In his final moments, Samson invoked God's covenant name and demonstrated Yahweh's unmatched supremacy over idols.
- Samson’s prayer showed a renewal of faith, even though it was still tainted by a desire for personal revenge.
- Scripture remembers Samson in Hebrews 11 as a servant of faith despite his serious moral shortcomings.
- Believers should thank God for using imperfect people while actively striving to put sin to death.

### Strength in Weakness
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/strength-in-weakness-one-year-devotions-for-men-august-26.html
Passage: Judges 16:28
Points:
- Samson's lack of discipline led to his captivity, blinding, and public humiliation before Israel's enemies.
- The Philistines attributed Samson's defeat to Dagon, turning Samson's downfall into mockery against the Lord.
- Standing between the pillars, Samson recognized his estrangement and acknowledged God as the true source of strength.
- Though Samson sought payback for his eyes, God used his sacrifice to display divine majesty over false gods.
- God continues to accomplish His divine purposes through flawed people who admit their dependence on Him.
